opening.text: みなさん、こんにちは。こよみ先生です。秋がふかまって、柿のおいしい季節になりましたね。今日は、秋の間違い探しを5問、いっしょに楽しみましょう。

rule.text: 左と右の絵をくらべます。90秒で、右の絵の違いを3つ探してください。

unchiku.text: ここで、ひと休み。秋の小話です。
「もみじ」は、葉の色が変わることをあらわす、むかしのことば「もみつ」から生まれたといわれます。
万葉集のころは、黄色い葉と書いて「もみち」と読むのが、ふつうだったそうです。
平安時代になると、赤いもみじが秋の主役になったといわれます。

ending.text: これで5問、おしまいです。おつかれさまでした。
15個の違い、いくつ見つかりましたか。画面で、今日の称号を見てくださいね。
次回も秋の絵で5問です。チャンネル登録をして、また来てください。

questions.prompt: Scene: looking out from inside an old Japanese house across a wooden veranda (engawa) into a small autumn garden in warm late-afternoon light. Background (upper middle): a persimmon tree with orange fruit and a moss-covered stone lantern among red maple leaves. Middle: the wooden veranda. Main objects: (1) a calico cat sleeping on a flat floor cushion on the veranda, with its striped tail curled neatly around its body; (2) a round wooden tray on the veranda holding exactly three persimmons, a brown clay teapot and two teacups, with a little empty space on the tray; (3) a large woven bamboo basket standing on the veranda; (4) a flat stepping stone just below the veranda edge with a pair of wooden geta sandals on it, the pair about one fourteenth of the picture width; (5) a few strings of dried persimmons hanging from the eaves at the upper right, kept below the top tenth of the picture. Each persimmon on the tray is about one sixteenth of the picture width.
questions.edit_prompt: Edit this illustration and make exactly these three small changes: (a) on the stepping stone, the BACK one of the two wooden geta sandals (the upper one) has no thong strap any more: only the plain wooden base is left; the front geta stays exactly the same; (b) on the round tray, add one more persimmon of the same size next to the three persimmons, so there are four; (c) the front small teacup on the tray becomes a taller, cylindrical teacup (about twice as tall), same color and same tea; the back teacup stays the same.
